author: Home Repair Tutor
description: It’s important to check the subfloor relative humidity, especially after self-leveling. I prime self-leveler with PRIMER-PS and let that cure. Then I embed the DITRA-HEAT mats. I activate the pressure-sensitive adhesive with a wood float and can immediately install the heat cables. This methods for installing heated floors is fast and doesn’t require thin-set mortar
title: Schluter DITRA-HEAT Mat Tips - #heatedfloor #ditraheat #schlutersystems #sponsored
